到家（到家（第22页）皇上拱拳对着空荡荡的窗口行礼，顺势趴在桌上，“昏”了过去。她睁开眼，就看着他，近在咫尺，近到苏念安可以数出来他才长出来的几根胡子。他的额头，他的鼻梁，他的唇，一张精致无比的面容，从哪个地方看都无可挑剔。如果说方才那眼神不是罂漓漓抛出来的，他莫奕从此在虚冥界倒着走，这个世间，也就只有那个死丫头敢这么着大刺刺死不要脸地赖上自己。罗十三走了都一天了，秦良玉和张令伸长脖子等着探马的消息，可也怪了，这两个探子一直迟迟没回来报告。秦良玉觉得这事有点不妙。随着一声声报平安的声音传来，赵强悬着的心终于放了下来，幸运的是大家只是受到了一点震荡，没有人受伤。里面的装潢都是前任房主留下来的有点土气，但是他们也没时间弄。舞台上，陈志明无与伦比地演唱还在进行着。这首‘星星’作为后世维斯塔的经典之作，被陈志明安排在格莱美现场演奏，就是为了向众人再次宣告，自己，并不比迈克尔杰克逊差。凤浅歌被制着穴道，不能动亦不能语，侧目望着他眼底翻涌的思绪，心莫名被揪得紧紧地，让她几近无法喘息，恍似有不属于她的思绪纷乱的涌上心头。恰这时，他忽然看到有一队人马正朝这走来。最前面坐在马上的正是他的儿子。而后面，一辆马车内，他妻子正从里面探出头来。她是万没有想到萧飏对凤浅歌竟存着那样的心，一个冷血无情的人一旦动了情，结果只会万劫不复，她夜氏一族荣辱兴衰都系她身，萧飏的失败也就是她的失败，更是她夜氏一门的失败。

Arriving home (arriving home (page 22)) The emperor saluted the empty window with his fists raised, then lay down on the table and "passed out". She opened her eyes and looked at him, so close that Su Nian'an could count the few strands of beard he had grown. His forehead, the bridge of his nose, his lips, and his extremely delicate face were impeccable from all angles. If the look in his eyes just now wasn't made by Yu Lili, Mo Yi would be walking backwards in this world from now on. Only that dead girl dared to stab him so shamelessly. Luo Shisan had been away for a day, and Qin Liangyu and Zhang Ling stretched their necks to wait for news about the spy. But it was strange that the two spies had not come back to report. Qin Liangyu felt that something was wrong. As a sound of safety came, Zhao Qiang finally felt relieved. Fortunately, everyone was only slightly shocked and no one was injured. The decoration inside was left by the previous landlord. It's a bit rustic, but they don't have time to do it. On the stage, Chen Zhiming's unparalleled singing is still going on. This song "Star" is a classic of later generations, and was arranged by Chen Zhiming to perform at the Grammys, just to declare to everyone that he is no worse than Michael Jackson. Feng Qiange was restrained, unable to move or speak, looking sideways at the thoughts surging in his eyes, her heart was inexplicably tightened, making her almost unable to breathe, as if it didn't belong to her. Confusing thoughts came to his mind. At this moment, he suddenly saw a group of people walking towards him. The person sitting at the front was his son, and behind him, his wife was sticking her head out of a carriage. Xiao Yang actually has such a heart for Feng Qiange. Once a cold-blooded person falls in love, the result will be eternal disaster. The honor and disgrace of her Ye family depends on her. Xiao Yang's failure is her failure, and it is also the failure of her Ye family.
